product.summary: Unastella designs and builds its own liquid rocket engines using an electric pump-fed cycle. Through its UNA EXPRESS series launch vehicles, it offers suborbital scientific payload flights, satellite launches, and, in the long term, manned suborbital space travel services.
product.problem_statement: Although South Korea has space launch vehicle technology (e.g., Nuri), it has been government-led, and no private company had performed the entire cycle from design to launch within the country. Global demand for small satellite launches has surged, but Korean startups, lacking launch infrastructure and licensing experience, had to rely on overseas launch sites.
product.solution: The company independently developed a 5-ton (50 kN) electric pump-fed engine and built its private launch site in Goheung, passing over 30 regulatory permits. The launch vehicle uses kerosene/liquid oxygen propellant and integrated its systems in a Lego-like block fashion to speed development.
key_features: 50 kN-class electric pump-fed liquid rocket engine (world's highest thrust for an electric pump-fed engine)
Kerosene/liquid oxygen combination (a global standard verified through over 5,000 launches)
Regenerative cooling combustor — first successful test in November 2026
Only private launch site in Korea (Goheung) and completed over 30 regulatory permits
Completed full cycle from design to launch in just 38 months
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: The electric pump-fed cycle is simpler in structure and more flexible in control than turbo pumps, significantly reducing costs and development time for small launch vehicles. The company is advancing two electric pump patents transferred from KARI. In the November 2026 test, the regenerative cooling method was applied for the first time, opening up possibilities for extended engine durability and flight time.
product.target_customer: Domestic and international research institutions (microgravity experiment payloads), small satellite operators (400 kg class, 400 km SSO), and in the long term, suborbital space tourists.
product.business_model: Sounding rocket launch services (carrying scientific payloads), satellite launch services (APEX 400S, customized dedicated launches), engine and component test stand rental, licensing assistance, and other launch infrastructure services. Long-term: selling seats for manned suborbital flights.

product.summary: FluoRok develops a manufacturing platform that uses mechanical activation to produce fluorochemicals directly from fluorspar or industrial waste, without any intermediate hydrogen fluoride (HF).
product.problem_statement: Modern essential chemicals (20% of pharmaceuticals, 33% of agrochemicals, and the lithium-ion battery electrolyte LiPF₆) all contain fluorine, but the manufacturing process still relies on HF, a method dating back 250 years. product.solution: FluoRok does not use HF; it reacts fluorspar powder with alkali metal compounds and titanium dioxide using mechanical energy to produce fluorochemicals. Calcium is fixed as calcium carbonate and recovered as a byproduct. The process operates at atmospheric pressure and low temperature (below 50°C) and can be scaled up using off-the-shelf process equipment.
key_features: No HF use, significantly reducing safety, capital costs, and regulatory burden.
Can use low-grade fluorspar and industrial waste fluorspar (waste fluorine) as raw materials, offering supply chain flexibility.
Mechanical activation + aqueous chemistry (water-based) for a low-temperature, atmospheric pressure process.
Achieves LiPF₆ purity of 99.99%+; battery cell certification in progress.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: A combination of patented mechanochemical activation and calcium sequestration technology. A reaction pathway that directly decomposes fluorspar (CaF₂) to release fluoride ions and capture calcium as carbonate.
product.target_customer: Lithium-ion battery electrolyte manufacturers (primary: LiPF₆), pharmaceutical and agrochemical raw material intermediate manufacturers (secondary: inorganic fluorides).
product.business_model: Generates revenue by supplying compounds produced in its own demonstrator facility to customers. Mid-term expansion to large-scale production through technology licensing or joint ventures (JVs).
